name: word_registry
grain: one row per English inner-being word
use: the study's entry point; scope of a new-word run

name: word_strong
grain: one row per (word, strong) the STEP word-search returned
use: L1 — the discovery record: which strongs a word maps to. These strongs are the basis for L2. Carries the link only, no strong detail.

name: strong
grain: one row per strong — unique, global to the study
use: L2 — the strong's identity. The meaning is normalised out (O4): it lives in strong_sense / strong_meaning_tree / strong_lexicon.

name: strong_sense
grain: one row per strong — the sense HEAD
use: the span's meaning, read constantly. The head is the first line of mediumDef (the sense); is_own_lemma marks a code that is its own lemma, where the gloss carries the sense.

name: strong_meaning_tree
grain: one row per sense-node of a LEMMA's definition tree
use: the lemma's full range — read rarely, only when the broader context is needed. Keyed on the lemma (shared across its senses, which the prototype proved).

name: strong_lexicon
grain: one row per strong that has LSJ/Mounce (Greek)
use: the large lexicon text — separate because rarely scanned

name: verse
grain: one row per verse — unique. Does NOT belong to a strong.
use: L3 — the addressable verse. preview is the full interlinear, kept verbatim so span is re-derivable.

name: strong_verse
grain: one row per (strong, verse) — unique. The m:m index.
use: the source's assertion 'this strong is in this verse'. The check side against span (what the parse found).

name: span
grain: ONE ROW PER CODE of a verse (O3) — particles get their own row
use: L4a — SOURCE, immutable. A parse of verse.preview. position is the running code index; (verse, position) is the key.

name: run
grain: one row per work-package run — the control record
use: what ran, pinned to a config version, and RESUMABLE (O7): state + resume_point persisted so a pause survives the process.

name: validation_result
grain: one row per check a validate step ran
use: util.validation — the outcome of a check, persisted so it can be inspected and reported. A passed check is a recorded fact, not just an advancing run.

name: escalation
grain: one row per researcher interaction — the pause
use: the only sanctioned researcher interaction. A pause, not a fork: the run resumes at resume_point when answered.

name: lemma_inventory
grain: one row per corpus lemma (base Strong's) — the INDEPENDENT substrate the seed net runs over
use: L4b seed substrate; imported from the old study, NOT derived from the registry, so the seed is a real completeness control

name: candidate_seed
grain: one row per assessed lemma — the over-inclusive Axis-A candidate assessment
use: L4b seed decision (potential, not definite); the lexical stage is the real test. registry_match NULL on a candidate = a candidate MISSING registry word (the double control)

name: span_candidate
grain: one row per CANDIDATE span (existence = candidate) — the L4b stamp over the L4a span
use: over-inclusive candidate stamp; the lexical stage later tests each in context

name: passage
grain: one row per passage — a reading frame (global, per book)
use: extends a characteristic's context to adjacent verses for assessing movement/process/qualifying spans; NOT a thematic unit

name: verse_passage
grain: one row per verse-in-a-passage — passage membership (L4b), keeps the raw verse pristine
use: which passage a verse belongs to; a verse is in at most one passage
